researchDepth: 14-Driver bounded landscape/construct/incident-edge audit and targeted primary-source/contrary checks. Not a systematic review per Driver; source-result access depths and uninvestigated cells explicit. No candidate yield requirement.

entityReviews.constructReview: Current response to an imminent/concrete threat, not diffuse anxiety or objective risk.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Fear/scared ratings differ from avoidance, startle and threat-appraisal scales; separate film narrative from actual danger.
entityReviews.timeReview: Seconds/minutes after a specified threat; not an enduring trait.
entityReviews.unresolved: Existing threat and risky-choice edges reused; composite reappraisal outcome does not establish a separate fear effect.

entityReviews.constructReview: Apprehension/tension about uncertain future threat; not diagnosis, stable punishment sensitivity or intolerance of uncertainty.
entityReviews.measurementReview: STAI-state mixes calm/upset and tension; DASS anxiety emphasizes somatic symptoms, while task worry is narrower. Common-method overlap with trait scales remains.
entityReviews.timeReview: Acute anxiety and four-week/trait outcomes separated.
entityReviews.unresolved: Cyclic-sighing anxiety superiority not established; EA-0008 remains UNKNOWN/research-needed.

entityReviews.constructReview: Current anger about offense, obstruction, injustice or blame; not aggression or stable hostility.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Angry/irritated ratings can overlap frustration; hostile attribution and confrontational behavior are not independent measures of anger itself.
entityReviews.timeReview: Episode-specific appraisal and later decisions require separation; regulation strategy is not available capacity.
entityReviews.unresolved: Films can co-induce fear; no pure-anger assumption or universal risk preference effect.

entityReviews.constructReview: Aversion/revulsion across contamination and moralized contexts; bodily and moral domains not identical.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Disgust adjective can express condemnation metaphorically; facial/nausea measures require alignment rather than semantic equivalence.
entityReviews.timeReview: Immediate elicitation versus stable sensitivity and later judgment distinguished.
entityReviews.unresolved: Moral-conviction→disgust sources misaligned; publication-bias-sensitive reverse-direction literature cannot validate it.

entityReviews.constructReview: Negative evaluation of the global self under exposure/failure; not guilt about a specific act.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Shame/embarrassment grouped item is not a pure shame measure; proneness, self-evaluation and cultural display norms differ.
entityReviews.timeReview: Current experience distinct from shame-proneness or years of socialization.
entityReviews.unresolved: Source PMID mismatch flagged; cultural tightness not exact shame-regulation norm manipulation.

entityReviews.constructReview: Negative evaluation of one's specific act/omission and responsibility, not global defective self.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Guilt/remorse items, reparative intention and behavior are not identical; scenario manipulations can bundle harm, agency and norm cues.
entityReviews.timeReview: Event-related guilt may persist, but hypothetical scenarios do not prove enduring moral change.
entityReviews.unresolved: General induction review insufficient for a precisely operationalized guilt action/effect or guilt→repair pathway.

entityReviews.constructReview: Current sadness in response to loss or unattained goals; not depression diagnosis or all unpleasantness.
entityReviews.measurementReview: DES sad/downhearted/blue aligns better than K6 depression/worthlessness or broad negative-affect totals. Film study extracted contrasts compare emotion profiles, not an isolated sadness-versus-neutral estimand.
entityReviews.timeReview: Retrospective rating of feelings during clip is not day-long mood or later recovery.
entityReviews.unresolved: EA-0009 remains research-needed pending exact clip/comparator contrast; no arbitrary universal film effect.

entityReviews.constructReview: Positive expectation/affect concerning a valued attainable future; not optimism trait or all goal agency/pathways.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Snyder-style agency/pathways scores and positive/hopeful compound items mix cognition/motivation with affect; no measure-as-construct equivalence.
entityReviews.timeReview: Current hope differs from multi-session goal therapy and stable expectancy.
entityReviews.unresolved: Candidate hypothesis only: exact affective component and goal/time referent unresolved.

entityReviews.constructReview: Positive self-evaluation around achievement/identity/recognition; authentic and hubristic components not interchangeable.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Separate seven-item facet scales, state versus dispositional prompts and social display; PANAS proud item cannot establish all dimensions.
entityReviews.unresolved: Intended source identified at PMID17352606, stored17352607 is a different paper. Facet-wide effect not inferred.

entityReviews.constructReview: Diffuse current bipolar pleasantness/unpleasantness; not every positive emotion or life satisfaction.
entityReviews.measurementReview: PANAS positive affect includes activation/alertness, and negative affect is a separate scale. Their sum/difference is not automatically canonical valence; film study explicitly reports PA problems.
entityReviews.timeReview: Momentary bipolar state versus retrospective week/month symptom composite distinguished.
entityReviews.unresolved: No generic mood effect retained from PANAS, positive-composite reappraisal or cash-transfer happiness.

entityReviews.constructReview: Consciously felt activation/alertness/agitation, not autonomic arousal.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Respiration, cortisol, heart rate, EMG and generic emotional intensity are not equivalent to subjective activation. Film 'no emotion–intense emotion' scale is an especially important proxy mismatch.
entityReviews.timeReview: Momentary activation during exposure, not inferred from physiological recovery or trait measures.
entityReviews.unresolved: Audience effect source bundle not exact evidence; no respiration→subjective-arousal shortcut.

entityReviews.constructReview: Aversive affect from blocked/delayed goal pursuit; not obstruction itself or aggression.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Self-reported frustration differs from response force, speed, frowning and task performance; replication found divergent channels.
entityReviews.timeReview: Proximity/effort before blockage and retrospective emotion after it; no dynamic trajectory from one report.
entityReviews.unresolved: Real blockage may elicit frustration, but exact manipulated Driver missing; task-world operation and perceived goal conflict/difficulty not conflated.

entityReviews.constructReview: Other-oriented care and concern for another in need, not self-compassion, personal distress or emotion sharing.
entityReviews.measurementReview: IRI empathic-concern items, donation behavior, empathic accuracy and neural sharing are different. Compassion interventions may target self, others or both.
entityReviews.timeReview: Current concern and multiweek habitual compassion outcomes require separate scope.
entityReviews.unresolved: Review active-control conclusions differ; exact target of compassion/measurement unsettled. No generic meditation→concern effect.

entityReviews.constructReview: Appraisal that demands exceed coping resources, not cortisol or all negative affect.
entityReviews.measurementReview: PSS unpredictable/uncontrollable/overload appraisal differs from DASS stress/tension and K6 distress. PSS past-month aggregation cannot silently stand for a momentary scalar.
entityReviews.timeReview: Canonical minutes/hours dynamics versus recalled past week/month, intervention follow-up and physiological recovery differ.
entityReviews.unresolved: Cash-transfer appraisal finding promising but timing/context and spillovers require scoped follow-up; no physiology pathway or broad policy effect.

existingReviews.rationale: Shame-regulation norms are distinct from national cultural tightness and an individual's shame report; country correlations do not identify within-person shame causation.
existingReviews.nullContrary: Variation in culturally meaningful exposure, role, audience and self-evaluation; shame/embarrassment overlap and Western sampling limit transfer.
existingReviews.proposal: Keep context-dependent semantics but require a specified norm, relevant exposure/role violation, independent shame measure and temporal design; no generic tightness→shame substitution.
existingReviews.rdsReview: Both endpoints are Drivers; no local RDS/derivation entitlement, direct RDS effect or duplicate aggregate propagation.
existingReviews.executionReview: Legacy proposition unchanged and V1 incomplete; no weights, onset/lag magnitudes, mediator or universal transfer inferred.

existingReviews.rationale: Anxiety is associated with poorer working-memory task performance and experimentally induced anxiety can impair tasks; task capacity/performance are not the entire available-resource construct.
existingReviews.nullContrary: Moran177 samples includes mixed findings; compensatory effort may preserve effectiveness even when efficiency changes.
existingReviews.proposal: Bound anxiety type, task/load, compensatory effort and timing; distinguish self-reported anxiety associations from induced-state contrasts and exact PSY-058 alignment.

existingReviews.nullContrary: Suppression can reduce expression without reducing experienced negative emotion; a composite reappraisal result does not establish anger-specific or capacity effect.
existingReviews.proposal: Specify capacity assessment separate from chosen strategy, deployment opportunity, goal and experienced-versus-expressed anger; identify causal design and timing.

existingReviews.nullContrary: Scale validation and transdiagnostic review do not independently manipulate stable sensitivity or establish every episode's response.

existingReviews.nullContrary: Between-person diagnosis associations cannot establish within-person causal changes or independent contributions of aggregated negative-affect items.
existingReviews.proposal: Measure trait separately before later PSS-aligned appraisal, preserve within/between-person distinction and item/content overlap; no diagnosis-to-stress proxy conversion.

existingReviews.rationale: Identity threat, identification, perceived injustice and anger are distinct. Collective-action meta-analyses do not isolate this exact threat→anger proposition.
existingReviews.nullContrary: Anger, fear or withdrawal can follow depending on appraisal/efficacy/context; SRC160/SRC-501 same umbrella source.
existingReviews.proposal: Specify threatened identity, devaluation/constraint manipulation and later experienced anger independently of collective-action/identity indicators; no universal direction or mediation.

hypotheses.question: Fear and anxiety are synonymous.
hypotheses.reason: Concrete imminent threat and uncertain future apprehension are distinct even when scales co-load.

hypotheses.question: Cyclic sighing reduces state anxiety more than an attention comparator.
hypotheses.reason: EA-0008 retains within-group change and between-group nondetection separately; no causal sign from pre/post alone.

hypotheses.question: Reduced breathing rate proves reduced subjective arousal.
hypotheses.reason: Physiology is not consciously reported activation.

hypotheses.question: PANAS positive affect improvement proves bipolar mood valence improved.
hypotheses.reason: Activation-containing score is not exact whole-construct valence.

hypotheses.question: Presenting specified film clips increases discrete sadness relative to neutral clips.
hypotheses.reason: EA-0009: differential emotion profiles and broad reviews promising, but exact same-item clip/comparator estimate not extracted; preserve mixed emotions.

hypotheses.question: A negative-emotion composite proves separate causal effects on all its Driver components.
hypotheses.reason: No inference from average to every component, including fear/anger/sadness/stress.

hypotheses.question: Reconstrual reduces exact experienced fear/anger/sadness in a pandemic context.
hypotheses.reason: Large randomized study uses composites; exact discrete outcome, demand and attrition need reconciliation.

hypotheses.question: Moral disgust amplifies later moral judgment.
hypotheses.reason: Publication-bias adjustment and confounds undermine universal sign; exact target PSY construct not selected from generic condemnation.

hypotheses.question: Moral conviction is equivalent to disgust intensity.
hypotheses.reason: Belief moralization, transgression appraisal and aversion are distinct.

hypotheses.question: Public-role norm reminders increase shame.
hypotheses.reason: Tightness not exact CUL-076 operation, audience and self-evaluation needed; reuse REL-CUL-047 review.

hypotheses.question: Shame/embarrassment combined ratings isolate shame.
hypotheses.reason: Grouped item cannot separate the two states.

hypotheses.question: Autobiographical specific-action recall increases guilt.
hypotheses.reason: Recall may bundle sadness, responsibility and shame; exact comparator and independent action/omission referent required.

hypotheses.question: Success feedback increases whole pride intensity.
hypotheses.reason: Authentic/hubristic facets and feedback attribution not uniform; no full construct claim from one subscale.

hypotheses.question: Agency/pathways hope equals current hopeful affect.
hypotheses.reason: Related cognitive/motivational and affective constructs need boundaries, not synonym edge.

hypotheses.question: Hope-focused therapy increases PSY-048.
hypotheses.reason: Agency/pathways scales and multi-session packages not exact current affect; no package efficacy from components.

hypotheses.question: Compassion practice increases empathic concern.
hypotheses.reason: Self-directed versus other-directed target and review/control differences unresolved; no generic meditation identity/effect.

hypotheses.question: More donations or shared neural activity prove greater empathic concern.
hypotheses.reason: Behavioral allocation and affect sharing are not caring concern.

hypotheses.question: Goal blockage increases frustration.
hypotheses.reason: Review reward-proximity/effort design; source report invalid force, no EMG difference and opposite RT expectation. Missing exact upstream Driver, not substitute goal conflict.

hypotheses.question: Faster or stronger responses are frustration itself.
hypotheses.reason: Replication separates self-report, motor and EMG; no proxy as semantic entity.

hypotheses.question: Cash transfers decrease perceived stress.
hypotheses.reason: Cohen4-item finding promising, but exact transfer/time/spillover comparison and canonical appraisal window needed before a formal candidate.

hypotheses.question: Support→perceived stress→physiological recovery is mediated.
hypotheses.reason: PRC chain not transmitted-effect evidence; care versus support perception and cortisol versus recovery slope must align.

hypotheses.question: A cortisol null means perceived-stress null.
hypotheses.reason: Different outcomes can diverge; source reports stress reduction and no average cortisol effect.

hypotheses.question: Vacant-land greening reduces momentary sadness.
hypotheses.reason: Cluster RCT supports certain K6 symptom items, not exact transient sadness; bundled cleanup/planting/fencing/maintenance cannot be split.

hypotheses.question: Sleep loss increases anxiety and reduces affective wellbeing.
hypotheses.reason: Reuse HT-V1-INF-F03-007 only if exact overnight operation matches; heterogeneous restriction/fragmentation not same identity; exact state/trait/time needs extraction.

hypotheses.question: Anxiety induction changes enduring intolerance of uncertainty or punishment sensitivity.
hypotheses.reason: State response is not demonstrated lasting trait change.

hypotheses.question: Certainty/control appraisals modify emotion→risk preference.
hypotheses.reason: Existing REL-PSY-026/027 exact edges identified; manipulation/mediator identification and PSY-013 versus attribution of control require follow-up.

hypotheses.question: Regulation capacity modifies identity threat→anger.
hypotheses.reason: Exact REL-PSY-046 known, but available capacity versus strategy, timing and independent interaction evidence absent.

hypotheses.question: Audience performance effects prove subjective-arousal mediation.
hypotheses.reason: Exact self-reported activation and transmitted path not measured by diffusion citations.

hypotheses.question: Anxiety and working-memory availability are inversely associated.
hypotheses.reason: Existing causal edge audit records association support; do not create duplicate until measurement/time/ownership split decided.

hypotheses.question: Shame precedes guilt in self-evaluation.
hypotheses.reason: No universal temporal ordering extracted; different states cannot TRANSITIONS_TO each other merely from theory.

hypotheses.question: Cultural or disaster occurrence proves every exposed person's emotional consequence.
hypotheses.reason: Exposure, appraisal, occurrence and consequence need separate evidence; no universal effect from contextual fact.

hypotheses.question: Stress and anxiety scales duplicate one another.
hypotheses.reason: Related tension/negative-affect content requires item/time-specific comparison, not automatic ontology merge.

canonicalSourceReviews.finding: Emotion-specific decisions depend on appraisal/context; no universal negative-valence sign.
Gross regulation review identity from canonical record; no newly extracted individual causal finding.
2026 IU review: definition/measurement remain debated; transdiagnostic correlations not exact enduring-trait causality.
Watson/Clark/Tellegen1988 two largely independent PA/NA scales; not a single bipolar valence score.
114 studies/241 effects of dispositional regulation associations with psychopathology; not capacity→anger experiment.
Five studies habitual reappraisal/suppression measurement and correlates; strategy use not available capacity.
Intended Decety/Jackson2004 DOI10.1177/1534582304267187 theoretical empathy architecture verified. Stored15556055 is an ACE-inhibitor heart-failure meta-analysis; no canonical repair.
Cohen/Kamarck/Mermelstein1983 DOI10.2307/2136404. Operational timing assessed from current study methods, not an invented abstract.
Moran2016 DOI10.1037/bul0000051:177samples22061 people, anxiety/WMC association and narrative experimental evidence; task and compensation limits.
Eysenck/Derakshan/Santos/Calvo2007 attentional-control theory: efficiency can decline while compensatory effort preserves effectiveness.
Same work as SRC-501; no independent replication of identity-threat→anger.
Social identity/collective-action meta-analysis; no new exact threat manipulation extracted.
BIS/BAS measurement work does not independently establish stable sensitivity→current anxiety.
Fear-appeal source identity retained; exact risk/fear and efficacy issues already in F02; no duplicate extraction.
Lerner/Keltner2001 DOI10.1037//0022-3514.81.1.146: induced and natural fear/anger differ in specified risk choices; reported mediation does not authorize pathway.

Intended Chapman/Anderson2013 DOI10.1037/a0030964 moral-disgust synthesis verified; stored23231569 is osteoporosis screening. Later experimental meta-analysis challenges amplification; no source repair.
Intended Tangney/Stuewig/Mashek2007 DOI10.1146/annurev.psych.56.091103.070145. Stored17576262 is infant attachment, not moral-emotions review. Shame/guilt distinctions retained; no repair.
Snyder2002 hope theory is agency/pathways-centered; no exact affective-state effect extracted.
Intended Tracy/Robins2007 DOI10.1037/0022-3514.92.3.506 seven-study authentic/hubristic facet validation; stored17352607 is Verplanken negative-thinking habit. No canonical repair.
Berkowitz1989 frustration/aggression reformulation; interference with expected goals not universal behavior or a measurement identity.
Eisenberg/Miller empathy/prosocial review identity; no newly extracted exact concern intervention.
Kotov2010 175studies BigFive/diagnosis associations; not an experimental neuroticism→current perceived-stress estimate.

Carleton/Norton/Asmundson2007 intended IUS-12 paper DOI10.1016/j.janxdis.2006.03.014 verified; stored10.1007/s10608-007-9154-z returned404. Anxious/avoidance measurement components, not causal trait manipulation.
NIMH RDoC definitions framework, not TDF and not empirical support for physiological recovery, load, support or audience effects.
RDoC units-of-analysis not an exact causal study; no physiological/subjective equivalence.
Gelfand33nation tight/loose culture work is not direct shame-regulation or moral-conviction→disgust evidence.
Preserve SRC160 same-work issue and stored author mismatch, no independent replication.
Prior F03 source concern: dehumanization/violence not exact moral-conviction/disgust endpoint; no new causal extraction.
Centola component duplicates SRC235; diffusion/topology not audience→subjective activation evidence. Bundle remains canonical unchanged.

queries: exact endpoint definitions and canonical source identifiers, EuropePMC PMID/DOI/title verification
searchLog.depth: Complete local fields; primary abstracts for anxiety/WMC, IU, regulation, PANAS, moral emotions, pride and trait diagnoses. Wrong PMID papers were inspected only to reject bibliographic linkage.

Primary selected Balban methods/results/limitations and coherent breathing DASS methods; primary FilmStim paper methods/Results3/discussion; review abstracts. All within-versus-between comparisons separated.
Wang author-hosted paper Methods/analysis and results: five-item emotion averages. Singh/Kirby/Kreplin abstracts, Weis primary review sections; no aggregate-to-component transfer.
Primary abstracts verify conflicting state/trait, measurement, response-force and EMG evidence; no equivalence or majority-vote synthesis.
Sleep and greening primary abstracts; cash-transfer primary IV.C/TableIV/AppendixA.2 selected text. All eight origins considered without external-Family audit. No new real-world occurrence ingestion.
